**Option 1: Formal & Detailed**

```email
Subject: Performance Review - [Date]

Dear David,

This email is to inform you that your performance review is scheduled for [Date] at [Time] in [Location/Platform - e.g., Conference Room A / via Zoom].

During this review, we will discuss your performance over the past [Review Period - e.g., quarter, year], your accomplishments, areas for development, and goals for the future.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to ask.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
```

```email
Subject: Performance Review - Let's Connect!

Hi David,

Just a quick note to let you know your performance review is scheduled for [Date] at [Time] in [Location/Platform].

We'll discuss your recent performance, accomplishments, and goals. 

Please come prepared to share your thoughts and feedback.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Best,

[Your Name]
```

**Option 3: Very Brief & Direct**

```email
Subject: Performance Review - [Date]

Hi David,

Please come prepared to discuss your performance and goals.

Thanks,

[Your Name]
```

**Remember to replace the bracketed information with the correct details!**  You might also want to include a link to any relevant documents (self-assessment form, review guidelines, etc.).
